def transform(grid):
    """
    Fill 1s with 3s between consecutive 9s in rows or columns.
    
    A cell with value 1 becomes 3 if it lies strictly between two 9s
    either horizontally (in the same row) or vertically (in the same column).
    Cells with 9 or positions outside all 9-pairs remain unchanged.
